subject: memori-labs
positioning: Agent-native memory infrastructure — 'Memory from what agents do, not just what they say.' LLM/datastore/framework-agnostic drop-in SDK; Cloud SaaS ou BYODB.

language_stack.core: Rust core (memori-labs/core/Cargo.toml) com bindings para Python via setuptools-rust
language_stack.storage: SQLAlchemy / CockroachDB optional extras; BYODB via postgres/cockroach; sentence-transformers + faiss-cpu para vector search

differentiators_observable: LoCoMo benchmark: 81.95% accuracy com 1,294 tokens avg (4.97% full-context)
Outperforma Zep/LangMem/Mem0 com 67% menos tokens vs Zep (README.md)
Attribution model com entity_id + process_id + session — multi-tenant por design
Advanced Augmentation: attributes, events, facts, people, preferences, relationships, rules, skills
LLM coverage: Anthropic, Bedrock, DeepSeek, Gemini, Grok, OpenAI (sync/async/streamed)
Framework coverage: Agno, LangChain, Pydantic AI
MCP transport support: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Warp, Antigravity
OpenClaw plugin nativo — drop-in memory para gateway (integrations/openclaw/)
Rust core com FFI bindings — performance-oriented
BYODB via pyproject extras: sqlalchemy, cockroachdb; supports postgres/cockroach
